Central Reg // 11/10/1939

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.    9468
                          11 10 39

Translation of Letter from Ta Lei Machinery Factory, Lane 826/21, Hart Road.

October 7, 1939.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

We beg to state that we are engaged in the manu-
facture of different kinds of lathes and water pumps
etc. in order to meet the demand of the community.
Owing to the difficulty of finding suitable premises
we have not been able to start work for sometime.
Meantime the lease of the premises of No. 21, Lane
No. 826, Hart Road has been secured and machines have
been installed. Although work has commenced difficulty
has been experienced in the recruitment of apprentices.
Those from the country, who are usually illiterates,
will not be of much use to the society when they com-
plete their course of training. With this end in
view, we intend to rectify the mistake. Through the
assistance of relatives and friends 18 apprentices
have been taken on, who will be given science, English,
Chinese and mathematics lessons by members of the Hua
I Research Association of Technology, 4 hours a day,
holidays excepted; and 4 hours practical training in
the factory. The course will take two years after
which period they will become educated people and

中央登记处 // 1939年10月11日

上海公共租界工部局警务处

总监办公室。    9468
                39 10 11

哈特路（Hart Road）826弄21号大雷机器厂来信译文。

1939年10月7日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务总监。

先生：

谨呈，本厂为满足社会需求，从事各类车床及水泵等产品的制造。由于难以找到合适的厂房，我们有一段时间未能开工。在此期间，已承租哈特路826弄21号的房屋，并安装了机器。虽然工作已经开始，但在招收学徒方面遇到了困难。来自乡下的学徒通常都是文盲，完成培训课程后对社会并无太大用处。鉴于此，我们打算纠正这一偏差。在亲友的协助下，已招收18名学徒，由华一科技研究社（Hua I Research Association of Technology，音译）的成员每日（节假日除外）为他们讲授科学、英语、中文和数学课程4小时；并在工厂内进行4小时的实操训练。课程为期两年，期满后他们将成为有文化的人，并
